title: A High-Performance Pauli-Algebra Framework for Large-Scale Quantum Simulations
summary: Efficient manipulation of Pauli-algebraic objects is a key bottleneck in the classical emulation and benchmarking of quantum algorithms for chemistry and many-body physics. This bottleneck appears in Hamiltonian construction, variational ansatz preparation, expectation-value and gradient evaluation, and real-time propagation, all of which require repeated Pauli-algebra operations. Here, we present a high-performance Pauli-algebra framework tailored to quantum many-body and quantum-chemical simulations.
